mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} ORDER BY `createtime` DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS `viewCount`, COUNT(DISTINCT `tag``ip`) AS `visitorCount`,
COUNT(CASE WHEN `createtime` >= CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS `todayViewCount`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `createtime` >= CURDATE() THEN `tag``ip` END) AS `todayVisitorCount`,
COUNT(CASE WHEN `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND `createtime` < CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS `yesterdayViewCount`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND `createtime` < CURDATE() THEN `tag``ip` END) AS `yesterdayVisitorCount`,
COUNT(CASE WHEN `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS `days7ViewCount`, COUNT(CASE WHEN `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND `createtime` < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS `lastDays7ViewCount`, COUNT(CASE WHEN `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS `days30ViewCount` FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId}
SELECT COUNT(0) as count, `ip_region` as `region` FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} GROUP BY `ip_region`
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createtime, '%H') AS `hour`, COUNT(0) AS `count` FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= CURDATE() GROUP BY `hour`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createtime,'%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(0) AS `count` FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 DAY) GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date` desc

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createtime,'%Y-%m') AS `date`, COUNT(0) AS `count` FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY `date` ORDER BY `date` desc
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND `createtime` < CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND `createtime` < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `t_statistics` WHERE `project_id` = #{projectId} AND `createtime` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
